answer: In this PoA design, each identity posts bonded collateral in an escrow, while correlated equivocation by k identities is detected through shared evidence and penalized at O(k^2), causing coordinated misconduct to exceed any benefit from splitting stake. Once a sybil swarm is proven, asymmetric depreciation applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss, making replacement identities economically futile. Thus comet, sparrow, and gale remain harmless labels unless they coordinate fraud.
